relationships.subject: 2-methyl-5-HT

relationships.subject: 5-HT3 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Morphine activates GABAergic interneurons in the SDH by activating descending serotonergic neurons

relationships.subject: K252a
relationships.evidence_quote: The increased analgesic effect of PAG morphine induced by bicuculline was reversed by pretreatment with the tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB) antagonist K252a

key_findings: PAG morphine raises spinal 5-HT and, via 5-HT3 receptors, spinal GABA in normal and SNL rats, but is not analgesic after SNL.
Bicuculline and ondansetron enhanced PAG morphine analgesia in SNL rats in a TrkB-dependent (K252a-sensitive) manner, consistent with a shift of GABAA signaling from inhibitory to facilitatory.
